decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 23 July 2003, the matter described above is lawful within the meaning of section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reasons:

The proposed extension, with dimensions 7.3m long by 1.7m deep and with a height of 3.2m, that adds 39.7m3 to the volume of the original dwellinghouse, shown on the plans constitute permitted development as defined by Schedule 2, Part 1, Class A of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995(as amended) and therefore does not require planning permission.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the proposed erection of a single storey side extension to dwellinghouse.
